scope: Read-only ADB inventory and rooting research. No APK installation, exploit execution, reboot, unlocking or flashing performed.

observed_security_state.note: Bootloader is currently locked. ADB properties do not establish whether an official unlocking procedure is available. KnoxGuard values are preserved as reported rather than interpreted as a confirmed Download Mode state.

magisk.assessment: The standard patched-firmware route requires an unlocked bootloader. No verified unlock procedure for this phone and build was established. Do not flash a patched AP, boot or init_boot image in the current locked state.
magisk.documented_consequences: Magisk's Samsung instructions warn of an irreversible Knox warranty-bit change and an initial data wipe.

temporary_root_candidate.route: DirtyFrag with a matching KernelSU-family backend and manager
temporary_root_candidate.eligibility_assessment: Observed model, codename, ABI, architecture, SDK, kernel family and page size match the published family requirements. This is an eligibility inference, not a successful root or vulnerability test.
temporary_root_candidate.limits: Root is lost after a full reboot or power loss. Attempts can freeze or reboot the phone. Firmware mitigations and vendor kernel compatibility can prevent success despite matching the family rules.
temporary_root_candidate.ghostlock_note: The project's GhostLock route requires the exact recorded AZHL identity, which does not match this AZAB phone.

research.next_step: Review a specific release and its matching manager, then plan a manual temporary-root trial with modules and automatic root disabled. Preserve this baseline and avoid firmware changes while assessing compatibility.
